title: New Web Based game - MelDash
author: SHAD0WDEM0N654
selftext:
Hi, All

I’m rather new to the game dev scene only messed with Godot, but my work was after a project for a charity event, and we all had crazy Ideas and my idea was a game that played simply online, via a web browser and mobile app, where players could donate 2 pound to enter a price draw and participate in a ranked scoreboard, and the top player wins a price by a certain date next year, overall quick jump to now and looks like my idea was not good enough, I used AI to develop abit of this project and it was great got a lot of great reviews on discord, and family and friends, even some clients, I would like to know would it still be a great game if I changed it to my own creation fully, moved it away from work and charity event, and turned it into a game called MelonDash or MelDash

Here is a video of the game in action it’s nothing special, but thanks for any feedback and opinions.
